column3: Request rate limiting is a deployment requirement of the API gateway (docs/operations/deployment.md, docs/architecture/overview.md). Endpoints that accept guessable credentials also have application throttles (src/middleware/bruteForceProtection.ts), which the query does not recognize.
The check only rejects a request without a token; the token is then verified against the recovery session before any action.
The X-NEXUS-Signature header selects device-signature authentication, which verifies the signature; the other branch requires a valid single-use BOOTSTRAP token. Both branches authenticate.
Operator command: a generated initial password and TOTP secret are printed once to the operator who runs it; the service never logs them.
Smoke test against a test deployment: prints the failing response for the operator.
SHA-256 over request bodies and public keys for request signing in test tooling; no password is hashed or stored.
